blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updatePromotions` method. This belongs to the Promotion Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).

types.name: data
types.description: The attributes to update in the promotions.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the promotion.

children.name: is_automatic
children.description: Whether the promotion is applied automatically.

children.name: code
children.description: The code of the promotion.

children.name: type
children.description: The type of the promotion.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description: Whether the promotion is tax inclusive.

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of times this promotion can be used.

children.name: status
children.description:
The status of the promotion:

- `draft` indicates that a promotion is currently being prepared
- `active` indicates that a promotion is active
- `inactive` indicates that a promotion is no longer active

children.name: application_method
children.description: The associated application method.

children.name: type
children.description:
The type of the application method indicating how
the associated promotion is applied.

children.name: target_type
children.description:
The target type of the application method indicating
whether the associated promotion is applied to the cart's items,
shipping methods, or the whole order.

children.name: allocation
children.description:
The allocation value that indicates whether the associated promotion
is applied on each item in a cart or split between the items in the cart.

children.name: value
children.description: The discounted amount applied by the associated promotion based on the `type`.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of the promotions application

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The max quantity allowed in the cart for the associated promotion to be applied.

children.name: buy_rules_min_quantity
children.description:
The minimum quantity required for a `buyget` promotion to be applied.
For example, if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the
value of this attribute is `2`.

children.name: apply_to_quantity
children.description:
The quantity that results from matching the `buyget` promotion's condition.
For example, if the promotion is a "Buy 2 shirts get 1 free", the value
of this attribute is `1`.

children.name: promotion
children.description: The promotion of the application method.

children.name: campaign_id
children.description: The associated campaign's ID.

types.name: sharedContext
types.description: A context used to share resources, such as transaction manager, between the application and the module.

children.name: transactionManager
children.description: An instance of a transaction manager of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `transactionManager`.

children.name: manager
children.description: An instance of a manager, typically an entity manager, of type `TManager`, which is a typed parameter passed to the context to specify the type of the `manager`.

children.name: isolationLevel
children.description: A string indicating the isolation level of the context. Possible values are `READ UNCOMMITTED`, `READ COMMITTED`, `REPEATABLE READ`, or `SERIALIZABLE`.

children.name: enableNestedTransactions
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether nested transactions are enabled.

children.name: eventGroupId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the group to aggregate the events to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: transactionId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current transaction.

children.name: runId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current run.

children.name: messageAggregator
children.description: An instance of a message aggregator, which is used to aggregate messages to be emitted at a later point.

children.name: requestId
children.description: A string indicating the ID of the current request.

children.name: idempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the current workflow execution.

children.name: parentStepIdempotencyKey
children.description: A string indicating the idempotencyKey of the parent workflow execution.

children.name: preventReleaseEvents
children.description: preventReleaseEvents

children.name: isCancelling
children.description: A boolean value indicating whether the current workflow execution is being cancelled.

children.name: cancelingFromParentStep
children.description:
Weither or not a sub workflow cancellation is being triggered from a parent step.
If true, the parent step will not be triggered by the sub workflow.

children.description: The ID of the promotion.

children.name: code
children.description: The code of the promotion.

children.name: type
children.description:
The type of the promotion:

- `standard` indicates that a promotion is a standard one applied with conditions.
- `buyget` indicates that a promotion is a "Buy X get Y" promotion.

children.name: status
children.description:
The status of the promotion:

- `active` promotion is available for user to consume
- `inactive` promotion is no longer available to the user
- `draft` promotion is currently being prepared

children.name: is_automatic
children.description: Whether the promotion is applied automatically.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description: Whether the promotion is tax inclusive.

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of times this promotion can be used across all orders.

children.name: used
children.description: The number of times this promotion has been used in completed orders.
